description: Curiosity rover found its target crater filled with sand, forcing NASA to abandon drilling plans. The rover is now studying nearby bedrock and preparing to sample a new sulfate-rich site to uncover Mars’ geological history.
title: NASA’s Curiosity Rover Finds Crater Filled With Sand, Alters Drilling Plans

description: This psychological thriller follows a Foley artist tormented by eerie visions and a mysterious voice since childhood. When he is accused of murdering his father, a gripping investigation begins, uncovering buried secrets and disturbing truths.
title: Suyodhana OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Telugu Mystry Thriller Online?

description: Control Ultimate Edition is now available on iPhone and iPad, Remedy Entertainment has announced. The game comes with universal purchase, controller support, and touch controls. Control Ultimate Edition includes the base game, two expansions, and other additional content.
title: Control Ultimate Edition Arrives on iPhone and iPad With Touch Controls, Universal Purchase

description: Instagram is celebrating the first anniversary of its Edits app, which was launched on April 22 last year. Commemorating its initial launch, Instagram’s Brett Westervelt, the head of the Edits app, said that since its release, the company has launched over 130 additional features for the platform, with the help of weekly updates. The company created a feedback loop, involding the creator community, which helped in the inception of various features, including the teleprompter tool. In its second year, the platform is set to see the integration of new functionalities.
title: Instagram's Edits App Turns One: How Meta Evolved Its Free Video Editing App and What's Next

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro has launched in India, competing with the OnePlus Nord 6 and Redmi Note 15 Pro+ in the premium mid-range segment. The Edge 70 Pro offers a 144Hz AMOLED display, Dimensity 8500 Extreme chip, and 6,500mAh battery. The OnePlus Nord 6 brings a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 processor, 165Hz display, and a large 9,000mAh battery. The Redmi Note 15 Pro+ focuses on imaging with a 200-megapixel camera and fast 100W charging, offering a balanced overall package.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro vs OnePlus Nord 6 vs Redmi Note 15 Pro+: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Asus has launched the ExpertBook Ultra alongside the ExpertBook P3 and P5 series in India, aimed at business users looking for AI-powered Copilot+ PCs. The ExpertBook Ultra brings a 14-inch OLED display, Intel Core Ultra processors with up to 50 TOPS NPU performance, and a lightweight sub-1kg design. Meanwhile, the P3 and P5 series offer more flexible configurations with Intel Core Ultra chips, up to 32GB RAM, and Wi-Fi 7 support. Pricing starts at Rs. 94,990, while the Ultra begins at Rs. 2,39,990.
title: Asus ExpertBook Ultra With Intel Core Ultra X7 Series 3 CPU Launched in India Alongside ExpertBook P3, ExpertBook P5 Series

description: Here are some of the top smartphones under Rs. 30,000 in India. The list includes Vivo T5 Pro, Infinix Note Edge, Redmi Note 15 Pro, Realme P4 Power, and Oppo A6 Pro. They are equipped with the latest mid-range chipsets from Qualcomm and MediaTek. They feature large attery units and dual or triple rear camera setups, including a 50-megapixel primary sensor.
title: Best Smartphones in India Under Rs. 30,000: Vivo T5 Pro, Infinix Note Edge and More

description: Redmi K Pad 2 has been launched in China. The new Redmi K Pad 2 joins the tech giant's compact tablet lineup. It is offered in three colour options, dubbed Deep Black, Electric Purple, and Space Silver (translated from Chinese). The tablet is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC, which is built on a 3nm process. Moreover, it is backed by a 9,100mAh battery, with support for 67W wired fast charging and 22.5W wired reverse charging. The Redmi K Pad 2 features a 13-megapixel single rear camera.
title: Redmi K Pad 2 Launched With 8.8-Inch 3K Display, Dimensity 9500 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Coinbase has launched USDC-INR trading for verified users in India, aiming to simplify crypto-to-fiat transactions. The rollout will expand across platforms in phases, as the company continues to navigate regulatory requirements and user demand in the Indian market.
title: Coinbase Announces USDC-INR Trading Services for Users in India

description: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon reportedly visited South Korea to meet Samsung executives. The company is reportedly in talks with Samsung Foundry for the production of Qualcomm's next-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite chips, aka Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoCs, using a 2nm process. The next-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series chipsets are likely to be released this year at the annual Snapdragon Summit. This chip is likely to be used in flagship smartphones from Samsung, Xiaomi and OnePlus.
title: Qualcomm CEO Reportedly Visits Samsung Foundry in Korea to Discuss Producing 2nm Chips

description: Boat Aavante Prime X has been launched in India as the company’s first truly wireless soundbar. As per the company, it combines a 7.1.4-channel surround sound setup, Dolby Atmos support, and wireless satellite speakers for a cinema-like experience at home. The soundbar has up-firing drivers and is accompanied by a wireless subwoofer. The Boat Aavante Prime X supports Bluetooth 5.3 and HDMI eARC in terms of connectivity.
title: Boat Aavante Prime X Soundbar Launched in India With Dolby Atmos, Wireless Satellite Speakers: Price, Features

description: Scammers posing as Iranian officials are targeting ships stranded at the Strait of Hormuz, demanding crypto payments for safe passage. Authorities warn that such transactions could carry sanctions risks, adding financial fraud concerns to an already tense geopolitical situation in a key global trade route.
title: Scammers Offer Passage to Ships Stranded Near Strait of Hormuz in Exchange for Crypto: Report

description: Honor 600 Pro and Honor 600 have been launched in select global markets as Honor’s latest N series smartphones, the tech firm announced on Tuesday. The handsets are currently available for pre-order in Saudi Arabia via the Honor online store. The two Honor 600 series phones are offered in Black, Golden White, and Orange colour options. While the Honor 600 Pro is powered by a Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, the standard model is backed by an octa core Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC. The two models boast 7,000mAh batteries, too.
title: Honor 600 Pro and Honor 600 Launched With 7,000mAh Batteries, 200-Megapixel Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: The Elden Ring live-action film adaptation will be released on March 3, 2028, Bandai Namco and A24 have announced. The companies also revealed the film's full cast and confirmed that it had begun production. The Elden Ring movie will be filmed for IMAX.
title: Elden Ring Film Adaptation Sets 2028 Release Date; Full Cast Revealed as Production Begins

description: Sennheiser has launched the CX 80U and HD 400U wired headphones in India with USB Type-C connectivity. Both support up to 24-bit and 96kHz audio playback and offer plug-and-play usage without pairing or charging. The CX 80U features a 9.7mm driver in a lightweight in-ear design, while the HD 400U offers an over-ear build with a detachable cable. Priced at Rs. 1,990 and Rs. 5,990, respectively, they include inline controls, MEMS microphones, and are available via online and offline retailers.
title: Sennheiser CX 80U, Sennheiser HD 400U With USB Type-C Connectivity Launched in India: Price, Features

description: OnePlus Watch 4 is currently listed on the company's global website. It features an LTPO OLED display with up to 3000 nits peak brightness. It ships with Oxygen OS Watch 8, based on Wear OS 6, and features a Snapdragon W5 chipset alongside the BES2800. It has a 646mAh battery and includes 2GB of RAM and 32GB of internal storage.
title: OnePlus Watch 4 Launch Appears Imminent as Listing Confirms Snapdragon W5 Chip, OxygenOS Watch 8

description: Vivo has confirmed that the X300 Ultra and X300 FE will launch in India on May 6 at 12pm IST. The X300 FE will arrive in Lilac Purple, Noir Black, and Urban Olive, with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip, ZEISS-backed 50-megapixel cameras, and a 6,500mAh battery with 90W charging. The X300 Ultra will feature a Zeiss Master Lenses system with 50-megapixel and 200-megapixel sensors, external telephoto lens support, 4K 120fps video, and a 6,600mAh battery with 100W charging and long-term software support.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300 FE India Launch Date Announced; Colour Options, Key Features Revealed

description: Apple announced on Tuesday that it will introduce stricter network security mandates with its next major iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS updates. Hence, the tech giant is asking IT administrators and device management service (DMS) developers to start preparing their network environments for the upcoming changes and conduct an audit to “identify servers” that are not compliant with the upcoming security requirements. This comes weeks before Apple's WWDC 2026 event, which is expected to see introduction of iOS 27.
title: Apple's iOS 27, macOS 27 and iPadOS 27 Updates Will Introduce Stricter Network Security Settings

description: Google released the latest Pixel drop earlier this month. While the update brought several new features, several Pixel users have posted complaints that their phone battery was suddenly draining much faster than usual after the update. The issue seems to have affected several Pixel generations. Users say that the battery drain is noticeable even when the Pixel is in aeroplane mode. Google acknowledged the issue, but no fix has been found just yet.
title: Pixel Users Report Severe Battery Drain After Latest Update; Google Working on Resolving Issue

description: OpenAI on Tuesday launched its next-generation image generation model. Dubbed ChatGPT Images 2.0, it is claimed to deliver more precise, usable, and context-aware images, based on prompts entered by the user. The new model introduces improvements in instruction following, multilingual rendering, and composition. The San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant says it also adds reasoning capabilities for more complex tasks. ChatGPT Images 2.0 is being rolled out across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.
title: OpenAI Unveils ChatGPT Images 2.0 With Improved Image Generation, Reasoning Capabilities

description: Tesla on Wednesday launched the long-wheelbase version of its popular SUV, the Tesla Model Y L Premium, in India. The new variant joins the standard Model Y in the company’s domestic portfolio. It brings a three-row seating layout, which is geared towards larger families. The EV has a WLTP range of up to 681km and is powered by a dual-motor all-wheel-drive setup. The Model Y L Premium also gets several features from the standard Model Y, including heated and ventilated front and second seats, adaptive suspension, and more.
title: Tesla Model Y L Premium Launched in India With 3-Row Seating, Up to 681km WLTP Range: Price, Features

description: Sony is expected to launch a new 1000X series headphone, with leaks revealing the “1000X The Collexion” model. Spotted briefly on Sony’s regional websites, the WH-1000XX is believed to mark the lineup’s 10th anniversary. It may feature active noise cancellation, a MediaTek MT2855 chip, and DSEE Ultimate support. The design is tipped to include metal hinges and a non-foldable build. Reports suggest black and white colour options, with a possible May 19 launch and a EUR 629 (roughly Rs. 67,600) price tag.
title: Sony 1000X The Collexion Reportedly Listed on Regional Websites, Expected to Launch Soon

description: Bitcoin traded near $78,100 on Wednesday as accumulation trends strengthened and ETF inflows improved. Despite rising demand, resistance near $78,000 continues to limit upside. Analysts say macro cues and institutional flows will determine the next move.
title: Cryptocurrency Prices Rise as Accumulation Strengthens Market Sentiment; Bitcoin Nears $78,100

description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) proposed a new change to its draft IT Rules amendments, bringing stricter guidelines for artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content labelling across online platforms. Additionally, the Ministry has also extended the consultation deadline to submit feedback on the new rules, pushing it from April 29 to May 7.
title: MeitY Adds Stricter AI-Generated Content Disclosure Rule, Extends IT Rules Feedback Deadline

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro has been launched in India, the tech firm announced on Wednesday. The handset is set to go on sale in the country via Flipkart. The handset is offered in three Pantone-curated colour options, dubbed Lilly White, Tea, and Titan, with each option sporting a different finish. The smartphone is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset. It also gets a triple rear camera unit, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter with a Sony LYT-710 sensor. The phone also supports video recording at up to 4K/60 fps. It is backed by a 6,500mAh battery, too.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Sony LYT-710 Camera: Price, Features

description: Pragmata has sold over a million copies, Capcom confirmed Tuesday. The company said that its new sci-fi IP surpassed 1 million copies sold in two days. Pragmata launched on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Switch 2 on April 17. Capcom said the game was largely developed by a team of younger Capcom staff.
title: Capcom Says Its New IP Pragmata Surpassed 1 Million Copies Sold in Just Two Days of Launch

description: Apple is said to be testing a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto lens for its future iPhone models. The first iPhone with a 200-megapixel telephoto camera may not launch until 2028. That would be a massive increase over the 48-megapixel sensors used in the latest iPhone 17 Pro models. Vivo's X series smartphones and Samsung's Galaxy S25 Ultra, Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Galaxy S26 Ultra use a 200-megapixel telephoto camera.
title: Apple Working on 200-Megapixel Periscope Telephoto Camera for Future iPhone Models, Tipster Claims

description: Oppo Find X9s has been launched in select global markets. The new smartphone is the second model in the Find X9s lineup, which also includes the China-exclusive Oppo Find X9s Pro. The handset is currently available for purchase via the Oppo Malaysia online store. It is offered in three colour options, dubbed Lavender Sky, Midnight Grey, and Sunset Orange. The phone will be available for purchase in a single 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configuration. The new Oppo Find X9s is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset and a 7,25mAh battery.
title: Oppo Find X9s Launched With Dimensity 9500s SoC, Hasselblad-Tuned 50-Megapixel Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: Spotify has introduced Ads Manager in India, a self-serve platform that allows businesses to create and manage advertising campaigns across audio, video and display formats. The platform includes targeting, measurement and creative tools, along with automation features aimed at improving campaign performance and accessibility for advertisers of all sizes.
title: Spotify Ads Manager Platform Launched in India, Brings Self-Serve Advertising to Businesses
Why the Samsung Galaxy A57 5G and A37 5G's 5000mAh Battery Outlasts Phones With 6000mAh

description: Oppo has launched the Watch X3 globally alongside the Find X9 Ultra and X9s Pro, after its China debut in March. The smartwatch features a titanium build, a 1.5-inch LTPO AMOLED display with up to 3000 nits brightness, and runs Wear OS 6 with Google apps. Powered by a Snapdragon W5 chip and dual-engine system, it offers ECG, advanced health tracking, and over 100 sports modes. The 646mAh battery is claimed to deliver up to five days in smart mode and 16 days in power saver mode.
title: Oppo Watch X3 Launched Globally With Titanium Build, 3,000-Nit OLED Screen: Price, Features

description: NoiseFit Diva Araya launched in India with an introductory price of Rs. 4,999. It comes with a glass-like ceramic build and is designed to be worn as jewellery. The wearable offers skin temperature monitoring and an SOS function. It has Bluetooth calling functionality. It offers a heart rate monitor and tracks blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) levels. Noise Diva Araya smartwatch features an AMOLED display with up to 850 nits of brightness.
title: NoiseFit Diva Araya Jewellery-Inspired Smartwatch With Ceramic Build Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Apple’s incoming CEO, John Ternus, is said to have already begun reshaping parts of the company’s operations with a particular emphasis on AI. Ternus’ formal transition into the Cupertino-based tech giant’s top role was recently confirmed and is set to take place in September. However, a report suggests that Apple's current Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering is already focusing on integrating AI more deeply into the company’s internal operations.
title: Incoming Apple CEO John Ternus Already Driving AI Overhaul Ahead of Leadership Transition: Report

description: Microsoft is rolling out a price cut for subscriptions to the Xbox Game Pass service in India and the global markets. The move, announced by the recently appointed Executive Vice President and CEO of Microsoft Gaming, Asha Sharma, comes months after the company significantly increased subscription prices and drew flak from its customers. However, it is not all roses as Xbox is also altering its day-one release strategy for one of its biggest franchises, Call of Duty.
title: Microsoft Cuts Xbox Game Pass Prices in India, Global Markets; Ends Day-One Call of Duty Access

description: Oppo F33 series was recently launched in India. The lineup includes two models, dubbed Oppo F33 Pro 5G and the standard Oppo F33 5G. Priced slightly under Rs. 40,000, the Oppo F33 Pro 5G features a unique design and vibrant colour options. Oppo’s F series is positioned to offer decent mid-range devices with a good user experience. The Oppo F33 Pro 5G features a dual rear camera unit, housed in a redesigned fibreglass deco. While it does closely resemble the iPhone 17 Pro's design, the smartphone maker has given the phone its own identity by curving the bottom of the deco.
title: Oppo F33 Pro 5G Review: The Best Looking Phone Under Rs. 40,000?
